comment: Canon costume colours, per fighter, for grading a GENERATED texture back onto model (tools/blender_grade_texture.py). Shared by both model backends, like billboards/src/states.js — render3d reads this file, it does not keep a copy. A generator matches a reference image's hue well and its VALUE badly: Yuji's uniform arrived at hue 226 degrees (correct navy) and 15% brightness (near-black), so he read as wearing black. Each region declares how to FIND its pixels and where to move them; grading preserves the shading inside a region rather than flattening it, so folds and creases survive. An entry may say `like: "<other key>"` to inherit that fighter's regions (its own `regions`, if any, are appended) — half the roster wears one uniform and would otherwise carry one copy of it each. Schema: characters.<key>.regions[] = { name, match: { hue: [lo, hi] in degrees or null for any, sat: [lo, hi], val: [lo, hi] }, target: { hue: degrees or null to keep, sat: 0-1 or null, val: 0-1 — the region's MEDIAN lands here, everything else scales with it } }. Ranges are on sRGB HSV. A region that matches nothing is reported, not silently skipped.

megumi.note: The Jujutsu High uniform, and the reference entry for it: navy, not black. A generator matches the hue and misses the value, so every fighter in this uniform arrives reading black. Fighters who wear it say `like: "megumi"` rather than copying these four numbers — see resolve_regions in tools/blender_grade_texture.py. His boots arrived brown and stay; the black under-layer is neutral, so the saturation floor excludes it.

yuji.note: Same uniform as everyone else (inherited); what is his alone is the footwear. The delivery baked cream/grey trainers and canon is red hi-tops.

regions.name: trainers
regions.note: The delivery baked cream/grey trainers. Matched as NEUTRAL and BRIGHT — nothing else on him is both — and set rather than scaled, since white has no hue or chroma to preserve. `minBlockFill` is what keeps it off the WHITES OF HIS EYES, which are the same colour and which duly turned red without it: a costume covers a contiguous patch of atlas, a highlight is a speck. The gum sole is warm enough to sit above the saturation ceiling and stays, which is what the reference shows anyway.

gojo.note: Same uniform, worn with the jacket zipped and the blindfold over it.

nobara.note: Same uniform; her hair is orange and well clear of the hue window.

inumaki.note: Same uniform, high collar up over the mouth.

maki.note: Same uniform, worn with the sleeves out.

todo.note: Kyoto's uniform rather than Tokyo's, but the same dark navy and the same failure.

hakari.note: Same uniform, worn open over a shirt — the jacket is the region that matters.

mechamaru.note: The puppet's robe is the same navy as the school uniform and arrived with the same near-black value.
